meaning_zh: {table_id}：在 {sheet}（{search}）里找不到写着 {anchor} 的单元格

meaning_en: {table_id}: {anchor} is in more than one cell of {sheet} ({refs}); narrow the search box
meaning_zh: {table_id}：{sheet} 里有多个单元格写着 {anchor}（{refs}）；请缩小查找范围

meaning_en: {table_id}: header {header} shows more than once ({refs}); only the first is mapped
meaning_zh: {table_id}：表头 {header} 出现不止一次（{refs}）；只映射第一个

meaning_en: {table_id}: no row of {sheet} starts with {stop} below the header; read to the sheet's last row
meaning_zh: {table_id}：{sheet} 表头下没有以 {stop} 开头的行；读到工作表最后一行

meaning_en: {table_id}: key header {header} is not in the table's header row
meaning_zh: {table_id}：键所用的表头 {header} 不在表头行里

meaning_en: {table_id}: row {row} has an empty key; matched by its content
meaning_zh: {table_id}：第 {row} 行的键为空；按内容匹配

meaning_en: {table_id}: row {row} repeats the key of an earlier row (occurrence {occurrence})
meaning_zh: {table_id}：第 {row} 行与前面某行的键重复（第 {occurrence} 次）

meaning_en: {table_id}: {ref} is a formula the file saved no value for; read as empty
meaning_zh: {table_id}：{ref} 是公式，但文件没有保存它的结果；按空值读取

meaning_en: {table_id} is not a confirmed table of the map; nothing is projected from it
meaning_zh: {table_id} 不是映射里已确认的表；不从它投影任何内容

meaning_en: {table_id}: {ref} does not read as {type}; left empty
